resources.string: Use this app virtually on another phone or laptop over Hotspot/Wi-Fi/USB, nothing to install

Connect any other phone or laptop to this phone via Wi-Fi hotspot, local network, or Type-C cable. The address below opens the full AndroidHarness AI agent studio in the other device\'s browser — zero installation needed on the other device.
Bridge active · Connect other phone to Hotspot/Wi-Fi
Bridge ready — type address in browser on the other phone/laptop
Turn on Hotspot or connect to Wi-Fi to get address
Hotspot/Tethering settings available in Android Settings → Network → Hotspot & tethering
Address for other phone or laptop
On the second phone or laptop, open Chrome or Safari and enter this URL to chat, speak with voice, and edit workspace files.
How to connect virtually from another phone

1. Turn on Wi-Fi Hotspot on this phone (or connect both phones to the same Wi-Fi network). 2. Connect your other phone to this phone\'s Hotspot. 3. Open Chrome or Safari on the other phone and type the address above. 4. Interact directly via voice dictation, chat with the multi-model AI team, and browse/edit phone workspace files with zero install on the second phone!
